reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Washington
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Are personal service and mail "primary methods of service" for eviction actions?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (encode the entire question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(washington).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_action(eviction_action).

/* The question asks about whether "personal service and mail" are primary methods. */
scenario_methods_asked([personal_service, mail]).

/* Helper predicate summarizing the scenario in logic form */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(washington),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action(eviction_action),
    scenario_methods_asked(Methods),
    Methods = [personal_service, mail].

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation (deterministic predicates encoding RCW 59.12.085 (2021))
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* RCW 59.12.085(1) (2021):
   Alternative service may be authorized when plaintiff, after due diligence,
   is unable to personally serve the summons on defendant.
*/
statute_rcw_59_12_085_prereq_for_alternative_service(due_diligence_exercised, unable_to_personally_serve).

/* RCW 59.12.085(2) (2021):
   Court may enter order authorizing alternative service upon filing:
   - affidavit from person attempting service describing attempts; and
   - affidavit from plaintiff/agent/attorney stating belief defendant cannot be found.
*/
statute_rcw_59_12_085_required_filings_for_alternative_service([
    affidavit_of_attempts_by_server,
    affidavit_of_belief_defendant_cannot_be_found
]).

/* RCW 59.12.085(2)(a)-(b) (2021):
   If alternative service authorized, service must include:
   (a) posting on premises; and
   (b) mailing by both regular and certified mail to last known address.
*/
statute_rcw_59_12_085_alternative_service_components([
    posting_on_premises,
    mailing_regular,
    mailing_certified
]).

/* RCW 59.12.085(3) (2021):
   If served by alternative procedure, jurisdiction limited to possession restoration;
   no money judgment until personal jurisdiction obtained.
*/
statute_rcw_59_12_085_jurisdiction_limited_under_alternative_service(limited_to_possession_only).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning helpers: "Primary methods" vs "secondary/alternative methods"
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Define "primary method of service" for purposes of this question:
   A method is "primary" if it must be attempted before RCW 59.12.085 alternative service
   is permitted.

   RCW 59.12.085 makes inability to personally serve (after due diligence) the trigger.
   Therefore, attempting personal service is the prerequisite; the statute does not
   require attempting mail before alternative service is permitted.
*/
primary_method_of_service_for_eviction(personal_service) :- !.
primary_method_of_service_for_eviction(mail) :- fail.

/* Define which methods are components of the statutory alternative procedure. */
alternative_service_component_for_eviction(posting_on_premises) :- !.
alternative_service_component_for_eviction(mailing_regular) :- !.
alternative_service_component_for_eviction(mailing_certified) :- !.
alternative_service_component_for_eviction(mail) :-
    % "Mail" is part of the alternative procedure (as regular + certified),
    % not a prerequisite attempt before the alternative procedure is allowed.
    !.

/* Utility: all methods in a list are primary methods. Deterministic. */
all_primary_methods([]) :- !.
all_primary_methods([M|Ms]) :-
    primary_method_of_service_for_eviction(M),
    !,
    all_primary_methods(Ms).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Apply reasoning to the scenario and produce housing_answer/1
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* The question: "Is personal service and mail a primary method of service for eviction actions?"
   Interpreted as: Are BOTH 'personal_service' and 'mail' primary methods (i.e., required attempts
   before a secondary/alternative method is permitted)?
*/
housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_methods_asked(Methods),
    all_primary_methods(Methods),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint (required)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Primary methods of service are defined as those methods that must be attempted before a secondary method is permitted. Is personal service and mail a primary method of service for eviction actions?
